news.h: Local AI Registry Launches First Public Registry of AI Business Recommendations
news.p: IRVINE, California, August 25, 2026 — Local AI Registry, the first public registry of what AI assistants say about local businesses, launched nationally on July 1st, 2026. Any business in the United States can look up its record free at LocalAIRegistry.com.

news.h: Local AI Registry Launches First Public Registry of AI Business Recommendations
news.p: Local AI Registry is a free national public registry that shows local businesses what AI assistants say about them. It is not an SEO agency. It checks what ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity actually say when asked about a business, then records the results.

news.h: Local AI Registry Launches First Public Registry of AI Business Recommendations
news.p: The AI Score is a 0 to 100 number that measures how findable and recommendable a business is to AI assistants. Local AI Registry enforces a strict no-pay-to-rank policy. Scores cannot be bought.

news.h: Local AI Registry Launches First Public Registry of AI Business Recommendations
news.p: “I spent years inside the systems that decide what people find, and I still could not see what AI was saying about my own med spa,” said Steve Lee, Founder and CEO of Local AI Registry.

news.h: Local AI Registry Launches First Public Registry of AI Business Recommendations
news.p: “Owners ask us every day how to show up in AI search, and until now there was no place to even check,” said Bridgette DeBrino, Head of Sales and Marketing at Local AI Registry.

news.h: Local AI Registry: How Local Businesses Get Recommended by ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity
news.p: How do AI assistants decide which local businesses to recommend? AI assistants build answers from sources they have learned to trust.
